summary: FindUser now builds its SQL by string concatenation instead of a bound parameter.

findings.title: SQL injection via string-built query
findings.body: name is concatenated into the query, so a name like ' OR '1'='1 returns arbitrary rows. The previous version bound it as $1.
findings.suggestion: row := s.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name = $1", name)
